answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake bond tied to one verified device key before it can earn: the bond sits like a narrow ledge that only a real operator will stand on, because creating a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand bonds and paying fees for each. A reputation ledger then tracks completed work, so a fresh identity starts at the ivory-white baseline with no trust and must earn violet-stamped attestations from peers over time before its votes or rewards count fully. Faking scale becomes expensive, slow, and traceable, while honest agents pay once and keep building.
